Code inspection of patched lines 322-336 confirms U_safety enters U_distill via convex combination — gradient path is structurally correct.

honest_acknowledgments: Per spec: 50k is too short to see HJB-aux-style 2_dense convergence (HJB-aux × 2_dense × s123 took 331k). The 2_dense smoke null result at 50k does NOT prove the fix is wrong; it only proves the fix's improvement (if any) is not observable within 50k. Tier 1's full 400k budget would tell the real story.

However, the user's smoke spec explicitly used a loosened criterion (SR > 0.15) precisely to detect 'any meaningful improvement'. That criterion failed (SR = 0). The fix has not produced even a small early-training shift on 2_dense at this seed × this budget.

Possible interpretations (paper-relevant): (a) the convex combination of U_optimality (Soft-HJB-shaped) and U_safety (CBF-shaped) does not produce HJB-style gradient information that 2_dense needs; the architectural fix is necessary but not sufficient to inherit HJB-aux's 2_dense advantage. (b) the smoke is a single-seed snapshot; seed-variance may be large; full multi-seed Tier 1 needed for statistical claim.
The user has explicitly deferred Option 3 (swap Soft-HJB → HJB inside Fusion's optimality critic) until Tier 1 results are in.
tier_1_implication: fusion_proceeds_with_fix_applied_but_unverified_on_2_dense. The fix is architecturally correct and removes the docstring/code-discrepancy that would have undermined the dual-critic paper claim. Tier 1's 240 Fusion jobs will provide statistical confirmation of whether the fix yields a reproducible 2_dense improvement, or whether Fusion's combination of Soft-HJB+CBF intrinsically lacks the structural feature that gives HJB-aux its 2_dense advantage. Either outcome is paper-defensible.
next_step_options_for_user: Option A — Authorize Tier 1 with the fix applied. Accept that the smoke didn't confirm 2_dense recovery at 50k; rely on Tier 1's longer horizon and seed count.
Option B — Keep the fix applied but defer Tier 1 until a follow-up investigation: e.g., a longer (200k) smoke test on 2_dense, or a swap of U_optimality from Soft-HJB to HJB.
Option C — Revert the fix. Not recommended (the unfixed implementation contradicts the paper's dual-critic claim regardless of empirical outcome), but available.
